question: What is the meaning of deconstructability in relation to sustainability features?
description: Deconstructability in relation to sustainability features refers to the ability of building parts to be dismantled and reused, promoting a circular building approach. It is based on two factors: the ratio of demountable connections and the ratio of prefabricated building elements. Demountable connections stimulate sustainable end-of-life scenarios for building components, while prefabrication reduces waste generation. The deconstructability score is calculated as the sum of demountable connections and prefabricated elements, with a higher score indicating better deconstructability. This feature supports material recovery and contributes to the overall sustainability of the building.
